{{Recipe}}

These '''toasted coconut flakes''' are a crunchy, caramelized snack made from fresh coconut. They are a popular snack in Nigeria.

== Ingredients ==

*Ripe fresh [[Cookbook:Coconut|coconut]]
*[[Cookbook:Granulated Sugar|Granulated sugar]]
*Salt

== Equipment ==

* [[Cookbook:Oven|Oven]]
* [[Cookbook:Grater|Grater]]
* Bowl
* [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|Baking sheet]]/tray

== Procedure ==

#Crack open the coconut, and separate out the coconut meat.
#[[Cookbook:Grating|Grate]] the coconut meat into flakes.
#[[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|Toss]] the coconut flakes with sugar and a [[Cookbook:Pinch|pinch]] of salt.
#Spread the coconut mixture on a [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheet]], and place on the lowest rack of the [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]]. Bake at 300˚F, stirring every few minutes until golden brown and crisp.
#Remove the coconut flakes and cool completely.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* Ensure you are fully concentrated while toasting the coconut, as it will burn quite fast.
* If you layer the coconut too thick on the pan, they will take very long to crisp up.
